name: @hasna/prompts
description: Reusable prompt library for AI agents — CLI + MCP server + REST API + web dashboard

scripts.build: bun run clean && cd dashboard && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build && cd .. && bun build src/cli/index.tsx --outdir dist/cli --external zod --target bun --external ink --external react --external chalk --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --external zod --target bun --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --external zod --target bun && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --external zod --target bun && bun build src/lib/dispatch/capture-helper.ts --outdir dist/lib/dispatch --external zod --target bun && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.tsx --outdir dist/cli --external zod --target bun --external ink --external react --external chalk --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
scripts.build:mcp: bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --external zod --target bun --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
scripts.build:server: bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --external zod --target bun
scripts.build:lib: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --external zod --target bun && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.build:helper: bun build src/lib/dispatch/capture-helper.ts --outdir dist/lib/dispatch --external zod --target bun
scripts.no-cloud:pack: bun run build && bun run scan:artifact
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run scan:artifact
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun test && bun run build && bun run scan:artifact

author: Andrei Hasna <andrei@hasna.com>
